answer: Exiting before the lock expires forfeits 31% of the bond outright, and the forfeit is burned so that nobody profits from it. Because the forge forfeiture is applied at exit, the kernel ledger totals each burn, and the garden audit records the amount lost per key. An operator that moves capital between 46 aliases therefore destroys value on every move, which makes rotation strictly worse than leaving the bond in place. That is 32 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
